g.text: SentryQR — End-to-End System Architecture & Protocol Flowchart
Complete Authentication Lifecycle: Device Key Enrolment • Challenge-Response Flow • 10-Step Verification Engine • DB Concurrency
LANE 2: OPTICAL AIR GAP & GUARD SCANNER
PHASE A — INITIAL DEVICE ENROLMENT & PKI REGISTRATION (ONE-TIME PER DEVICE)
(Private key is hardware/browser locked; cannot be exported)
2. Export Public JWK only (x, y coordinates)

svg.text: POST /api/students/keys { jwk: { kty: "EC", crv: "P-256", x, y } }

g.text: • Asserts kty==='EC' && crv==='P-256' & valid base64url coordinates
• Strict Safety: Rejects payload immediately if private scalar d is present
1. Deactivates existing active key for user
UNIQUE INDEX: 1 active key per user
PHASE B — DYNAMIC CHALLENGE–RESPONSE GATE ENTRY PROTOCOL & 10-STEP VERIFICATION
• Triggered automatically every 30s or on gate approach
• Sets timestamps: issued_at = Date.now(), expires_at = issued_at + 45000 (45s TTL)

svg.text: 201 Created { studentId, nonce, issuedAt, expiresAt, ttlMs: 45000, message }

g.text: • Computes ECDSA signature over canonical byte buffer
Dynamic QR Code Display (45s TTL Countdown)
✓ Auto-refreshes every 30s — Screenshots become stale & worthless
• Guard camera captures screen pixels via html5-qrcode
• Zero Network Path: No packet exists between devices
Guard app parses nothing locally (Dumb terminal model)
• Guard device submits raw decoded string to server
• Computes: crypto.verify('SHA256', msg, publicJWK, sig, dsaEncoding:'ieee-p1363')
✓ Client modifications to payload fields (sid, iat) are completely ignored (T3/T4 Defeated)
UPDATE nonces SET status='consumed', consumed_at=? WHERE nonce=? AND status='issued'
Critical Lock: Execution must yield changes === 1. Prevents concurrent verification race conditions
Payload: { decision: "GRANT", reasonCode: "OK", student: { fullName, rollNo, roomNo } }
Displays Student Name, Roll No & Room No on screen
Audio chime played • Turnstile Gate Opens
• Row retained for historical verification audits
✓ Immediate Gate Enforcement: Next scan fails Step 9
Student must re-enrol new device with credentials
Case: Student phone battery dead / camera damaged
Neither student nor warden can fabricate entry records
All failures logged with precise machine reason codes
• Password hashed with scrypt + 16B random salt
✓ Immediate Gate Invalidation: Rejects with STUDENT_INACTIVE
Profile data linked via foreign keys to hostel records
